Board Layout skills for component placement, routing, stack-up definition, and manufacturability considerations. Radio Frequency (RF) design skills for high-frequency layouts, impedance control, and signal integrity in RF circuits. Understanding of EMC/EMI, high-speed design practices, and industry standards for PCB fabrication and assembly. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and capability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams on-site in Surat.

Serve as a point of contact for internal and external partners on behalf of the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance. Maintain organized records, files, and workflows, ensuring important information and commitments are easily accessible. Monitor and follow up on outstanding items to ensure timely completion. Represent the CFO and Finance organization with professionalism, credibility, discretion, and integrity at all times. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially PowerPoint and Excel. Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly understand and navigate complex business priorities. Strong judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle highly confidential information. This cannot be overstated. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to work both strategically and tactically; comfortable switching between big-picture thinking and detailed execution. Ability to work independently, anticipate needs, and make sound decisions with limited direction.
